title: Armistice Day
content: Italian-born British illustrator Fortunino Matania captured the frenzied joy as news of the end of the "Great War" echoed through Europe on the 11th hour of the 11th day of the 11th month, one hundred years ago today.----Resources and LinksBook:Drawing from History: The Forgotten Art of Fortunino MataniaArtice onMatania in Illustrator's Magazine.Catalog of original works and prints by MataniaPrevious posts:Matania famous demo of the Belgian barricadeMatania's props and modelsFortunino Mataniaon Wikipedia
